# Hostizzy

> India's premier vacation rental management company. We empower property owners with technology-driven management and deliver exceptional guest experiences.

## About
Hostizzy (brand of Hostsphere India Pvt Ltd) is a vertically integrated hospitality technology company managing 35+ premium vacation rentals across India. We combine professional property management with proprietary technology (HostSuite, formerly HostOS) to maximize owner revenue and guest satisfaction.

## What We Do
- **Full-Service Property Management**: End-to-end vacation rental management including marketing, guest communication, housekeeping, maintenance, and revenue optimization
- **Technology**: HostSuite, our property management system (formerly HostOS), which also powers book.hostizzy.com. We also build ResIQ, an app for independent homestay owners, and JuxTravel, a trip-matching app for travellers
- **Multi-Channel Distribution**: Properties listed on Airbnb, Booking.com, Agoda, MakeMyTrip, and direct booking channels
- **Revenue Optimization**: Dynamic pricing, occupancy forecasting, and channel performance analytics
- **Guest Experience**: Curated luxury stays with concierge services, personalized itineraries, and quality assurance

## Products
- **HostSuite** (https://hostos.hostizzy.com), formerly HostOS: Hostizzy's property management system, "HostSuite by Hostizzy". The system Hostizzy's own operation runs on, and self-serve SaaS for other hosts from ₹999/month with a 14-day free trial (no card). Unified inbox (WhatsApp, Instagram, webchat, Gmail) with an AI Concierge and Niva, the AI agent; Email Intelligence that turns OTA confirmation emails into bookings; bidirectional iCal sync; GST invoicing; owner statements and payouts. The domain stays hostos.hostizzy.com. Android app coming to Google Play.
- **ResIQ** (https://resiq.hostizzy.com): App for independent homestay, villa and farmstay owners, usually working with a caretaker. Bookings, payments, guest ID verification, WhatsApp templates; works offline. Live on Google Play (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.hostizzy.resiq) and the web. Not aimed at management companies. Founding offer: the first 10 owners keep their first property free.
- **JuxTravel** (https://juxtravel.com): Trip-matching app for Indian travellers. Starts from the trip you want rather than a city and two dates. Independent hosts only. Launched 15 September 2026, live across India on Android (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.hostsphere.juxtravel).
- **Booking Site** (https://book.hostizzy.com): Direct booking site for Hostizzy-managed properties, powered by HostSuite

## Detailed Product Information

### HostSuite (formerly HostOS) - Property Management System
HostSuite, "HostSuite by Hostizzy", is Hostizzy's property management system, built for the Indian vacation rental market. It is the system Hostizzy's own operation runs on, and since 2026 it is sold to other hosting businesses as self-serve SaaS at https://hostos.hostizzy.com (the domain did not change with the rename). Plans start at ₹999/month, with custom pricing for large portfolios; every plan has a 14-day free trial with no card required. Tagline: "Everything a host needs. Together."

Key capabilities include:
- **Unified Inbox**: WhatsApp through the official Meta Cloud API, Instagram DMs, webchat and Gmail in one inbox.
- **AI Concierge**: Off / Suggest / Autopilot modes, a lead parser, drafts in the guest's language across 10 Indian languages, polish and hot-lead alerts.
- **Niva**: The AI agent. Answers guests on WhatsApp and Instagram, quotes, holds dates and sends payment links; the team approves discounts.
- **Email Intelligence**: Turns confirmation emails from Airbnb, Booking.com, MakeMyTrip, Goibibo, Agoda, Expedia and VRBO into reservations, and extracts payout, commission, GST, TDS and TCS.
- **Channel Sync**: Bidirectional iCal sync with a monitoring dashboard, plus a 7-stage enquiries pipeline.
- **Money**: GST and non-GST invoicing with CGST/SGST/IGST and HSN codes; Razorpay payment links; owner portal with statements, payouts and P&L; expenses.
- **Guests and Agreements**: Guest portal (check-in, KYC, meal pre-order, payment, review); SignFlow digital agreements with WhatsApp OTP and e-signature.
- **Marketing and Reviews**: Broadcasts; review import from Airbnb, Booking.com, MakeMyTrip and Google with AI summaries.
- **Also**: Activity and event bookings, loyalty programme, AI listing agent, multi-room inventory, a direct booking website (it powers book.hostizzy.com), and English + Hindi interface.
- **Mobile**: Android app "HostSuite by Hostizzy" coming to Google Play. No iOS app yet.

### ResIQ - App for Independent Homestay Owners
ResIQ (https://resiq.hostizzy.com) is an app for people who own a homestay, villa or farmstay in India and run it themselves, usually with a caretaker on site. It is a separate product from HostSuite and is not aimed at property management companies. Live on Google Play (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.hostizzy.resiq) and on the web.

Key capabilities include:
- **Bookings**: Enquiries and bookings in one place; calendar feeds from Airbnb, Booking.com, Agoda, MakeMyTrip and Goibibo, and booking emails imported from Gmail. One-way into ResIQ today; two-way sync is in testing.
- **Payments**: Advances and balances across cash, UPI, gateway and bank transfer, with payment reminders.
- **Guest KYC**: Guests scan a QR code, upload Aadhaar or passport, take a selfie and pick meals; documents auto-delete 60 days after checkout.
- **WhatsApp Templates**: Confirmations, directions, payment nudges and thank-yous in English or Hindi, logged against the booking.
- **Caretaker Login**: Caretakers see arrivals and departures and can check guests in, without seeing revenue, payouts or bank details. Invite by email, revoke in one tap.
- **Works Offline**: Bookings, payments and check-ins work with no network and sync when signal returns.
- **Android and Web**: Native Android app with offline mode, push notifications and biometric login; web app on any device.
- **Pricing**: Founding offer, the first 10 owners keep their first property free permanently. Accounts are approved by the team, usually the same day.

### JuxTravel - Trip-Matching App for Travellers
JuxTravel (https://juxtravel.com) launched on 15 September 2026 and is live across India on Android (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.hostsphere.juxtravel). No iOS app yet. Travellers describe the trip they want; Jux Fit matches them to independent homestays and villas, the Reality Layer shows honest trade-offs before booking, an AI travel companion helps on the go, and Passport keeps a record of every trip. Independent hosts only, no chains. Hosts can list at https://juxtravel.com/homestay-owners. Hostizzy-managed homes are listed on the same terms as any other host.

## Host Academy
Hostizzy's Host Academy is an educational initiative designed to elevate the standard of vacation rental hosting across India. The program offers structured training for property owners who want to improve their hosting skills, whether they self-manage or use professional management services.

### Training Programs
- **Hosting Fundamentals**: A beginner course covering property listing optimization, photography tips, pricing strategies, and guest communication best practices
- **Revenue Mastery**: Advanced training on dynamic pricing, seasonal revenue strategies, multi-channel distribution optimization, and competitive analysis
- **Guest Experience Excellence**: Training focused on creating memorable stays through thoughtful amenities, local experience curation, and service recovery techniques
- **Property Compliance**: Guidance on local regulations, tax compliance (GST for vacation rentals), safety standards, and insurance requirements

### Certification
Hostizzy Certified is a Host Improvement Program with three tiers — Bronze Host, Gold Host, and Platinum Host. Certified hosts earn 15-25% higher rates, receive priority support, and are featured in curated marketing campaigns. The certification process involves: Apply Online → Property Audit → Complete Training → Earn Your Badge.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How do I list my property with Hostizzy?
Simply visit our Contact page or use the Property Lead form. We'll schedule a discovery call to assess your property and recommend the best management plan.

### What are your management fees?
We offer five plans: SmartStart (₹14,999 one-time setup), ChannelPro (₹15K-40K/month channel management), Hybrid Core (18% commission), TotalCare360 (30% profit share for villas), and StayPrime (50-50 split for apartments with full management including staff and consumables).

### Do you handle guest vetting?
Yes, we use strict verification processes across all booking platforms to ensure high-quality guests. Our guest portal (in HostSuite) includes built-in guest KYC with document verification.

### What happens if a guest damages my property?
We collect security deposits and assist with insurance claims through platforms like Airbnb AirCover.

### Can I use my own property?
Absolutely! You can block dates for personal use anytime through the Owner Portal.

## Detailed Service Plan Features

### SmartStart
One-time onboarding for new hosts entering the vacation rental market. Includes property audit, professional photography, listing creation and optimization across major OTAs, initial pricing strategy, and access to HostSuite. Priced at ₹14,999 as a one-time setup fee.

### ChannelPro
Ongoing OTA channel management for hosts who handle operations themselves. Includes multi-channel listing management, calendar synchronization, pricing optimization, booking coordination, and monthly performance reporting. Priced at ₹15,000-40,000/month based on property portfolio size.

### Hybrid Core
Commission-based co-hosting model combining OTA management with direct booking support. Includes everything in ChannelPro plus direct booking channel setup, guest communication handling, and revenue optimization. Charged at 18% of net revenue.

### TotalCare360
Complete villa and farmhouse management with a 30% profit share model. Includes professional operations, marketing, guest communication, housekeeping coordination, maintenance management, revenue optimization, and dedicated property manager assignment.

### StayPrime
Full apartment management with a 50-50 revenue split. Includes everything in TotalCare360 plus staff management, consumables, and complete operational responsibility — the owner doesn't need to lift a finger.

## Technology Stack
Hostizzy's technology infrastructure is built on modern, scalable frameworks designed for reliability and performance:

- **Frontend**: Next.js (React), Framer Motion for animations, Tailwind-inspired custom CSS
- **Backend**: Node.js, Firebase (Firestore, Authentication, Cloud Functions, Storage), Supabase (PostgreSQL)
- **Hosting**: Vercel (website), Vercel + Supabase (HostSuite)
- **Analytics**: Google Analytics 4, custom event tracking
- **Communication**: WhatsApp Business API, automated email systems
- **Payments**: Razorpay integration for direct bookings, UPI support
- **SEO**: next-sitemap, JSON-LD structured data, server-side rendering
- **Channel Management**: API integrations with Airbnb, Booking.com, Agoda, MakeMyTrip
- **AI**: OpenAI GPT-5-mini for AI chatbot, revenue estimation, and content generation
- **AI Chatbot**: Conversational assistant on every page — answers questions about services, pricing, locations, and qualifies property leads
